DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請者のお名前を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Titiyakin po ang pangalan ng aplikante.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 登録はこの長い名前です。会社の申込書では短く書いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 登録名と申込略名の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ito ang mahabang nakarehistrong pangalan. Sa application ng kumpanya, mas maikli ang sulat ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kaibhan ng rehistradong pangalan at pinaikling application name. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明書は登録内容に基づきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nakabatay ang sertipiko sa nakarehistrong detalye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社に合わせて、短い名前の証明書を作れるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先に合わせ任意変更できないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya hindi basta makakagawa ng sertipikong may maikling pangalan para itugma sa kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawaing hindi malayang babaguhin para sa pagsusumitan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。表記が違う場合は、提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Kung magkaiba ang sulat, tiyakin sa pagsusumitan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の用紙を見せます。私の登録名と同じ人だと分かる資料が必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同一人照合の必要を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ipapakita ko ang form ng kumpanya. Gusto kong itanong kung kailangan ng patunay na parehong tao ang nakarehistrong pangalan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pangangailangang pagtugmain ang iisang tao. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先に確認する内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ayusin natin ang mga itatanong sa pagsusumitan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 登録名、申込名、生年月日を示して、申込側を直す必要があるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先へ示す情報と質問を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ipapakita ko ang rehistradong pangalan, application name, at petsa ng kapanganakan, at itatanong kung kailangang iwasto ang application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ayusin ang impormasyon at tanong sa pagsusumitan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それが確認できてから、必要な証明書を選べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kapag natiyak iyon, maaaring piliin ang kailangang sertipiko.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は勝手に名前を省略せず、登録名を控えて会社へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 省略せず会社確認まで発行を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi ko paiikliin basta ang pangalan ngayon. Itatala ko ang rehistradong pangalan at tatawag sa kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag paikliin; hintayin ang kumpirmasyon ng kumpanya bago ilabas. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発行は確認後にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ikonsulta ang paglalabas pagkatapos matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査結果の用紙についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tanong po sa papel ng resulta ng pagsusuri?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。「陰性」とあります。全部の検査に問題がないという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一つの陰性表示が全検査の判断を示すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. May “negative”. Ibig sabihin walang problema sa lahat ng test?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung isang negative ay paghatol sa lahat ng test. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの項目の結果かを確認する必要があります。診療上の説明は担当に伺いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangang tiyakin kung aling item ang resulta. Ang paliwanag na medikal ay itanong sa nakatalaga.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上から三番目の項目です。別の欄には、まだ結果待ちと書いてありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示の項目と別の結果待ち欄を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ikatlo mula sa itaas. Sa ibang kahon, nakasulat na naghihintay pa ng resulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ituro ang item at ibang kahong naghihintay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つの結果と、まだ結果が出ていない項目を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hiwalay nating tiyakin ang isang resulta at mga wala pang resulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この言葉だけで、すべて終わったと考えてはいけないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一語だけで検査全体終了と解釈しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kaya hindi dapat isipin na tapos lahat dahil sa salitang ito lamang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyaking isang salita ay hindi pagtatapos ng lahat ng test. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 全体の判断や次の対応は、診療担当へ質問してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itanong sa medikal na nakatalaga ang kabuuang paghatol at susunod na gagawin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三番目の結果の意味と、結果待ちの項目をいつ確認するか、二つ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当該結果の意味と未確定項目の確認時期を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawa ang gusto kong itanong: kahulugan ng ikatlong resulta at kailan titiyakin ang mga hinihintay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang kahulugan at oras ng pagtitiyak sa di-pinal na item. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご質問を伝えます。用紙をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaabot ang tanong. Panatilihin ang papel nang ganyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 結果待ちの欄を消さず、この用紙を見せて説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用紙を保ち診療担当の説明を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi ko buburahin ang kahong naghihintay. Ipapakita ko ito at pakikinggan ang paliwanag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang papel at sabihin na tatanggap ng medikal na paliwanag. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当の説明を確認してから、次の予定をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Tiyakin ang paliwanag bago pag-usapan ang susunod na plano.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メールで何を求められましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: アカウントの本人確認で、身分証の写真を返信するよう書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 身分証写真の返信要求を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sabi, para sa identity verification ng account, mag-reply ng litrato ng ID.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang kahilingan ng ID photo sa reply. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は送信しましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 添付まではしましたが、まだ送っていません。下書きに残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 添付済みだが未送信と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Naka-attach na pero hindi pa naipadala. Nasa draft pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing naka-attach ngunit hindi naipadala. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送信前と送信済みでは状況が違います。差出人を確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magkaiba ang bago at matapos magpadala. Natiyak na ang nagpadala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前はサービス名ですが、普段の通知とアドレスが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示名と送信元の不一致を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pangalan ng serbisyo ang nakadisplay, pero iba ang address sa karaniwang abiso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ituro ang hindi tugmang display name at sender address. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのメールへの返信ではなく、正規の窓口で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa opisyal na contact tayo magtiyak, hindi sa pag-reply roon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 公式アプリの問い合わせを使います。下書きを誤送信しないよう、添付を外しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 公式窓口へ確認し誤送信を防ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gagamitin ko ang inquiry sa opisyal na app. Aalisin ko ang attachment para hindi aksidenteng maipadala ang draft.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin sa opisyal na contact at iwasang aksidenteng maipadala. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談用にメールの内容と受信時刻を残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itabi ang nilalaman at oras ng pagtanggap para sa konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内容は保存しました。写真を送っていないことを明確にして相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内容を保存して未提供の状態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Na-save ang nilalaman. Lilinawin kong hindi ko naipadala ang litrato kapag nagtanong.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: I-save ang nilalaman at iulat na hindi pa naibigay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。操作した範囲を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itatanong nang sunod-sunod ang mga ginawa ninyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物のサイズは確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Natiyak na ang laki ng padala?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中の箱は三十センチです。小さい料金になると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 商品寸法を荷物サイズとして申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tatlumpung sentimetro ang kahon sa loob. Sa tingin ko maliit na rate ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang sukat ng produkto bilang laki ng padala. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送では梱包した外側の大きさを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa pagpapadala, panlabas na sukat matapos balutin ang tinitingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 緩衝材を巻いたので、外側は大きくなっています。中身の寸法だけでは決められませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 梱包後の外寸が必要と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Binalutan ko ng cushioning, kaya lumaki ang labas. Hindi puwedeng sukat ng laman lang ang batayan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawaing kailangan ang panlabas na sukat matapos balutin. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。三辺と重量を測ってご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Susukatin ang tatlong gilid at timbang at ipapaalam.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 測ってください。料金を小さくするために緩衝材を全部取るのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保護材を保ち実測を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisukat. Ayokong alisin ang lahat ng cushioning para lang bumaba ang bayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang proteksiyon at humiling ng aktuwal na sukat. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 品物を保護できる梱包が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kailangang protektahan ng balot ang produkto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このまま測った料金を聞いてから送るか決めます。外側の突き出した部分も含みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 突起の扱いと見積後の判断を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakikinggan ko ang rate sa sukat na ganito bago magpasiyang ipadala. Kasama rin ang nakausli sa labas?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang nakausli at pagpapasiya pagkatapos ng estimate. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 含めて確認します。テープで収められる所は整えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kasama sa pagtitiyak. Ayusin natin ang puwedeng isara ng tape.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 角を整えました。保護は残したまま、仕上がった箱で見積もってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外形を整えた箱で料金確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naayos ko ang mga sulok. Pakitantiya sa tapos na kahon habang nananatili ang proteksiyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng rate para sa kahong naayos ang panlabas. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の寸法と重量で料金をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ibibigay ang rate ayon sa kasalukuyang sukat at timbang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約する振込日は、この日でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tamang ito ang araw ng nakaiskedyul na transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。支払期限が日曜日なので、その日に届けばよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 休日の支払期限に合わせた予約を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Linggo ang deadline, kaya sapat na makarating sa araw na iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng schedule para sa deadline na holiday. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約日と処理の時刻、相手口座への反映は確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangang tiyakin ang petsa, oras ng pagproseso, at pagpasok sa account ng tatanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日曜日を選べても、期限内に届くと保証されるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 選択可能日と着金保証を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya kahit mapili ang Linggo, hindi garantisadong pasok sa deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang mapipiling araw at garantisadong pagdating. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。利用方法と金融機関の条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Ipapaliwanag ang paraan at mga kondisyon ng institusyong pinansiyal.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先方の案内には金曜日までに手続きとあります。日曜だけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先方の事前手続き指定を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa gabay ng tatanggap, dapat asikasuhin pagsapit ng Biyernes. Linggo lang ang tinitingnan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Basahing muli ang maagang pag-asikasong itinakda ng tatanggap. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その指定なら、実行日を早めることもご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung ganoon, isaalang-alang ang mas maagang execution date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金曜日の予定に変えたいです。変更後の画面で日付も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実行予定を早め変更日を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Gusto kong gawing Biyernes. Titiyakin ko rin ang petsa sa screen pagkatapos baguhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agahan ang nakaiskedyul na pagsasagawa at tingnan ang binagong araw. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ実行前の予約ですので、設定方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hindi pa naisasagawa ang schedule, kaya ituturo ang setting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。完了した時には、予定日ではなく実際の処理結果を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定だけでなく実処理結果を見ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Kapag natapos, aktuwal na resulta ang titingnan, hindi lang nakaplanong petsa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang tingnan ang aktuwal na pagproseso, hindi plano lang. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。結果の確認方法も合わせてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Opo. Ipapaliwanag din ang paraan ng pagtitiyak sa resulta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日はありません。この袋を買えば、袋持参の特典が付きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入袋が持参扱いになるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala ngayon. Kung bibilhin ko ito, makukuha ang benepisyo sa pagdadala ng bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung bibilhing bag ay ituturing na dinala. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このお会計では持参した袋ではありません。特典の条件はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa checkout na ito, hindi ninyo ito dinalang bag. Narito ang kondisyon ng benepisyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋を買う代金と、持参の特典は別なんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋代と特典条件を分けて理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya magkaiba ang bayad sa bag at benepisyo sa pagdadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawain nang hiwalay ang bayad at kondisyon ng benepisyo. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。袋の購入は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Opo. Kailangan bang bumili ng bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚お願いします。重い瓶がありますが、この大きさで大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要枚数と重い品への適合を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Isa, pakiusap. May mabigat na bote; ayos ba ang laki nito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang dami at itanong ang angkop sa mabigat. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量と耐荷重の案内をご覧ください。無理に詰めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tingnan ang kapasidad at limitasyon ng bigat. Huwag piliting punuin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 瓶二本とパンなので、瓶は袋へ、パンは手で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容量に合わせ品物を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawang bote at tinapay, kaya bote sa bag at tinapay sa kamay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Paghiwalayin ang mga gamit ayon sa kapasidad. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その袋を購入分として計上します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Isasama ang bag bilang biniling item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。特典は付かない金額で払います。次から袋を持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特典なしの会計を了承し次回持参を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Babayaran ko nang walang benepisyo. Sa susunod magdadala ako.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tanggapin ang walang benepisyo at magpasiyang magdala sa susunod. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋もレシートでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Salamat. Tiyakin din ang bag sa resibo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 売店をお探しですか。今日は営業を終えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hinahanap ang tindahan? Sarado na ngayong araw.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そうでしたか。飲み物がなくなったので、もう一周する前に買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飲料不足と周回前の購入希望を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ganoon ba. Naubos ang inumin, kaya bibili bago isa pang ikot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kulang na inumin at balak bumili bago umikot. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理棟のそばに飲料の販売機があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: May drink vending machine malapit sa administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では先にそちらへ行きます。ここから離れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 補給先までの距離を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Doon muna ako. Malayo ba mula rito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang layo sa kukunan ng dagdag na suplay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この園路をまっすぐ進んだ所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Diretso sa landas ng parke na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布に小銭がありません。使える支払方法が分からなければ、管理棟で聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小銭不足のため決済方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Walang barya sa pitaka. Kung hindi alam ang paraan ng bayad, puwedeng magtanong sa administration building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang bayad dahil walang barya. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内できます。必要なら散歩を短くして退園することもお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaari. Kung kailangan, isaalang-alang na paikliin ang lakad at lumabas sa parke.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。飲み物を確保できなければ一周はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確保できなければ散歩を短くすると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Kung walang makuhang inumin, hindi na iikot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang paikliin ang lakad kung walang makuha. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 販売機のそばに休める所もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: May pahingahan din malapit sa makina.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこで一度休み、飲み物と体調を確認してから続きを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補給後に休んで継続を判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Magpapahinga roon, titiyakin ang inumin at pakiramdam, saka magpapasiya kung tutuloy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpahinga pagkatapos ng suplay at magpasiyang magpatuloy. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理のない範囲でどうぞ。管理棟へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11235-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Huwag pilitin ang sarili. Pumunta sa administration building.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運転状況のご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この券で乗る予定でしたが、別の路線から行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延で経路変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Balak gamitin ang tiket na ito, pero nais kong dumaan sa ibang linya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagbabago ng ruta dahil sa delay. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別経路での切符の扱いは、今の案内と券の種類で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titiyakin ang tiket sa ibang ruta ayon sa kasalukuyang gabay at uri ng tiket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ目的地ならそのまま使えると思いました。まだ別の券は買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未購入のまま同一目的地の認識を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko puwedeng gamitin kung pareho ang destinasyon. Hindi pa bumili ng ibang tiket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkaunawang iisang destinasyon at hindi pa nakabili. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご購入の券を拝見します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これです。振替の対象か、買い直す必要があるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手持ち券の振替対象と買直しを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito. Sabihin kung saklaw ng alternatibong ruta o kailangang bumili muli.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagiging saklaw at pagbili uli ng hawak na tiket. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が現在の取扱いをご案内します。先に別の改札へ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ang nakatalaga ang magpapaliwanag. Huwag munang pumasok sa ibang gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。余計な支払いになる前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他改札へ進まず処理を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dito maghihintay. Nais kong tiyakin bago magbayad nang hindi kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag pumunta sa ibang gate; hintayin ang pagproseso. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。この券の処理をしてから別経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Natiyak na. Ipoproseso muna ito bago ituro ang ibang ruta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。処理の控えも受け取り、別路線の券は案内後に買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の券の処理と控え受取後に購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Tatanggapin ko rin ang katibayan, at bibili ng tiket ng ibang linya pagkatapos ng gabay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bumili matapos maproseso ang orihinal at matanggap ang katibayan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 順にご案内します。元の券をお預かりして確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Gagabayan nang sunod-sunod. Tatanggapin muna ang orihinal upang tiyakin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の際に希望されることはありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を忘れやすいので、スマホで録音したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 聞き直すための録音希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Madali kong makalimutan ang paliwanag, kaya gusto kong i-record sa phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng recording upang muling mapakinggan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 録音の扱いは担当へ確認します。どの目的で使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Titiyakin sa nakatalaga ang recording. Para saan gagamitin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家で聞き直すためです。ネットへ出すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私的な目的と公開予定のなさを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pakikinggan sa bahay. Walang balak ilagay sa internet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang personal na gamit at walang publikasyon. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を予約に添えますが、録音できると今はお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Isasama sa booking, ngunit hindi pa maipapangakong puwedeng i-record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。できない場合は、重要な点を紙に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 録音不可時の書面案内を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Kung hindi, maaaring isulat sa papel ang mahalagang punto?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang sulat kung bawal ang recording. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談内容に応じて担当へお尋ねください。ご自身でメモを取る準備もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Itanong sa nakatalaga ayon sa paksa. Maghanda ring magtala mismo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ノートを持って来ます。聞き取れなければその場で要点を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分のメモと要点確認を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Magdadala ng kuwaderno. Kung hindi marinig, titiyakin ang pangunahing punto roon mismo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Maghanda ng sariling tala at pagtitiyak sa mga punto. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。録音するなら開始前に担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Bago magsimula, tiyakin sa nakatalaga kung magre-record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約の希望欄には目的も書いてください。返事があるまで録音は始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始前の担当確認を約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Isulat din ang layunin sa request field. Hindi magsisimula hanggang may sagot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipangakong titiyakin sa nakatalaga bago simulan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録方法のご希望としてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ipapasa bilang kahilingan sa paraan ng pagtatala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後の忘れ物でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。検査の説明用紙を持って出たはずですが、かばんにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査説明用紙の不在を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Dala ko raw ang test information sheet paglabas, pero wala sa bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Iulat na wala ang test explanation sheet. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察室以外で用紙を出した場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Saan inilabas ang papel bukod sa examination room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計の前に待合の机で読みました。そこに置いたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に読んだ場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Binasa sa mesa ng waiting area bago magbayad. Baka naiwan doon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang huling pinagbasa. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付で確認します。ほかの方の用紙を自分で探して開かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan sa reception. Huwag maghanap at magbukas mismo ng papel ng iba.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私の名前が書いてあるかも確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人名義の確認を係員へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Pakitiyak din na may pangalan ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipatsek sa kawani ang sariling pangalan. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ照会します。次の検査日も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tatanungin ang nakatalaga. Alam din ang susunod na test date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週木曜日です。見つからなければ、必要な準備をもう一度説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査日と再説明の希望を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Susunod na Huwebes. Kung hindi makita, gusto kong muling ipaliwanag ang kailangan ihanda.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang araw at humiling ng paliwanag muli. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それも診療科へ伝えます。準備内容は受付で推測してご案内しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sasabihin din sa medical department. Hindi manghuhula ang reception ng paghahanda.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。検査まで日があるので、説明を受けた用紙を確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 推測せず正式な説明を確認して帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. May panahon pa bago test, kaya titiyakin muna ang papel na may paliwanag bago umuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag manghula; tiyakin ang opisyal na paliwanag bago umuwi. Sabihin sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できるまでお待ちください。担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11237-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maghintay hanggang matiyak. Gagabayan ng nakatalaga.
